decisions.title: Publication, status and scope communication
rules: Documented technical checks do not establish independent academic verification.
Published UI does not imply Published teaching content.
Product depth CORE/DEEP/BEYOND and exam-board content/entry classifications are separate fields.
A mathematically consistent illustrative model is not described as empirically fitted.
Board/year coverage is not claimed before a selected official objective set is mapped and reviewed.
decisions.evidence: User requested honest implementation scope; the master specification and current scope dialog require draft/model limitations.
